### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

## A Global Social Enterprise That Delivers Results

DKT is a leader in providing affordable sexual and reproductive health products and services. Each
year, DKT markets and distributes hundreds of millions of sexual and reproductive health
products—enough to protect millions of couples from unintended pregnancy each year. 

We are a non-profit with a commercial mindset, harnessing the power of the private sector to make
lasting impact in the lives of individuals and couples.

behavior change communications and capacity building of healthcare providers, we ensure people
everywhere have the information and resources they need to thrive.

## Making Contraception Accessible and Affordable

Decades of data collection and research on social marketing indicates that if individuals are
willing to invest a small amount of money to purchase contraceptives, they are more likely to use
them. 

DKT maintains affordability by pricing products based on purchasing power, ensuring that
contraceptives are readily available through supply-side interventions, and offering premium
products to subsidize economic brands. Offering a wide range of high-quality products at affordable
prices helps DKT meet the diverse needs of people around the world. From textured condoms to
long-acting reversible contraception, individuals are empowered to make informed choices about their
health and future at a price point that works for them.

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

# If you have type 2 diabetes—your kidneys need attention!

[LEARN MORE ][10]

## INVOKANA^{®} is the first type 2 diabetes medication proven in a landmark clinical study to lower
## the risk of:
* **End-stage kidney disease (ESKD)**
* **Worsening of kidney function**
* **Cardiovascular death**
* **Hospitalization for heart failure**

In adults with type 2 diabetes and diabetic kidney disease (nephropathy) with a certain amount of
protein in the urine.

### [Johnson & Johnson wants to help you explore cost support options for INVOKANA^{®}.][11]

[We’d like to help! Learn if you’re eligible for savings options, and get support. ][12]

[EXPLORE SAVINGS OPTIONS ][13]

## **INVOKANA®** also:
* **Lowers the risk** of **heart attack**,** stroke**, or **cardiovascular death** in adults with
  type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease.
* **Lowers blood sugar (A1C)** in adults and children aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes,
  along with diet and exercise.

[LEARN MORE ][14]

[2 red kidney caricatures holding hands]

## Type 2 diabetes can **really hurt your kidneys**—and you may not even know it’s happening.

Our kidneys work hard to do some **very** important things for us. But unfortunately, type 2
diabetes can cause **diabetic kidney disease**, a serious situation that can have **no early
symptoms** and can lead to dialysis, transplant, hospitalization for heart failure, and even death.
What should you do? What’s an **eGFR number**—and why is it important to know it?** Learn the
answers** to these important questions and more here.

[GET THE FACTS ][15]

[Journal of Research in Medical and Dental Science][30] (J. Res. Med. Dent. Sci.) was established in
the year 2013 and ever since its inception the journal is continuously publishing peer-reviewed
scientific articles. The Journal is a completely open access periodical disseminating latest
insights, advancements and innovations in medical and dental sciences focusing on Human physiology,
Surgical Science, Neonatal & Child Health, Mental Health, Dentistry, Pharmacology, Biomedical
informatics and Nursing.

JRMDS aims to promote research in the field of Medicine and Dentistry while providing an opportunity
for expression of individual opinions and critical reviews in health science. All articles are
published at a monthly issue release frequency under Creative Commons Attribution License CC-BY-NC
[4.0] in both PDF and HTML formats and accessible without any charge or embargo. The sections of the
articles including abstracts and references are published exclusively in English language.

The Journal welcomes original research articles, systematic and critical reviews, short
communications, and letters to editor, opinions and perspectives. All the submissions undergo
quality assessment and peer-review and the final publishable articles are determined by the Editors.
The Journal is listed in Gdansk University of Technology, Ministry, Index Copernicus. Researcher
Life, Research Bible, Research Gate, ABCD index, CiteFactor, Resurchify, Ingenta Connect, Journal
Seek, SJIF, Scinapse, Socolar, HINARI, Google Scholar, Euro Pub and Publons.

* Journal h-index : 19
* Average acceptance to publication time (5-7 days)
* Average article processing time (30-45 days) Less than 5 volumes 30 days
  8 - 9 volumes 40 days
  10 and more volumes 45 days

[Journal of Research in Medical and Dental Science][30] (J. Res. Med. Dent. Sci.) was established in
the year 2013 and ever since its inception the journal is continuously publishing peer-reviewed
scientific articles. The Journal is a completely open access periodical disseminating latest
insights, advancements and innovations in medical and dental sciences focusing on Human physiology,
Surgical Science, Neonatal & Child Health, Mental Health, Dentistry, Pharmacology, Biomedical
informatics and Nursing.

JRMDS aims to promote research in the field of Medicine and Dentistry while providing an opportunity
for expression of individual opinions and critical reviews in health science. All articles are
published at a monthly issue release frequency under Creative Commons Attribution License CC-BY-NC
[4.0] in both PDF and HTML formats and accessible without any charge or embargo. The sections of the
articles including abstracts and references are published exclusively in English language.

The Journal welcomes original research articles, systematic and critical reviews, short
communications, and letters to editor, opinions and perspectives. All the submissions undergo
quality assessment and peer-review and the final publishable articles are determined by the Editors.
The Journal is listed in Gdansk University of Technology, Ministry, Index Copernicus. Researcher
Life, Research Bible, Research Gate, ABCD index, CiteFactor, Resurchify, Ingenta Connect, Journal
Seek, SJIF, Scinapse, Socolar, HINARI, Google Scholar, Euro Pub and Publons.

For any further queries regarding the journal you can contact:

## Welcome to Road and Trail

This is a motorcycling enthusiast website created and actively maintained by a longtime motorcycle
rider. Here you will find well documented BC motorcycle riding routes, motorcycle reviews,
motorcycle servicing information, plus some additional content. The riding routes are divided into
paved roads (primarily) and dual sport / adventure (varied surfaces). Portions of some of the routes
are suitable for off-road motorcycles. Have fun, and ride safe.

#### Featured

[ [2023 CRF300L, Mabel Lake, South Cascade Road (2026)] ][17]

##### 2023 Honda CRF300L Review

Owner review of the 2023 Honda CRF300L. Applicable to the 2021 - 2024 model years. Relevant to the
2025 bikes as well (some minor updates to the 2025 bikes).

[View][18]
[ [2024 Honda NX500, Lumby Mabel Lake Road] ][19]

##### 2024 Honda NX500 Review

Owner review of the 2024 Honda NX500. Applicable to the 2024 - 2026 model years. CFMoto Ibex 450
test ride notes.

[View][20]
[ [2026 KLX230R S and 2022 CRF250F] ][21]

##### 2022 Honda CRF250F Review

Owner review of the 2022 Honda CRF250F. Applicable to the 2019 - 2025 model years as there have been
no major updates to the CRF250F during that time. Brief comparison to 2026 KLX230R S.

[View][22]
[ [Sugar Lake FSR, June 2026] ][23]

##### Sugar Lake, Sugar Lake FSR, Greenbush Lake, Kate FSR

Sugar Lake Road (off Hwy 6, Cherryville), Sugar Lake FSR past Sugar Lake to Greenbush Lake. Some
nice views along the way. Optional side trips: Rainbow Falls (Monashee Provincial Park) and Kate
FSR.

[View][24]
[ [2010 DR650SE Aberdeen, Okanagan BC (2025)] ][25]

##### 2010 Suzuki DR650SE Review

Long term owner review of the 2010 Suzuki DR650SE. Applicable to the 2002 - 2026 DR650SE / DR650S
(and somewhat to older model years).

[View][26]
[ [Mabel Lake FSR (2011)] ][27]

##### Lumby to Three Valley Gap to Enderby-Mabel Lake Road via Mabel Lake FSR, Three Valley Mabel
##### FSR

Starts with pavement, but mostly dirt and gravel roads. Mabel Lake Provincial Park, forests, creeks
and lakes. Wap Lake, Cottonwood Beach, Frog Falls and Noisy Creek Rec Sites.
